name: Kamishiro Moe
source:
A soft-spoken girl who politely addresses her [url=https://vndb.org/c12868]older brother[/url] as Nii-sama. But that is just her outside appearance. Inside, she is just as dangerous as [url=https://vndb.org/c12876]Kako[/url] with her sharp tongue. She also dislikes [url=https://vndb.org/c3132]Sayaka[/url] to the point of calling her "otenko" ("Great Airheaded Girl").

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/922090-suika-as/faqs/58095]neo-X-saga's Walkthrough[/url]]
